pooled_mann_whitney.note: computed separately (scripts had scipy.stats.mannwhitneyu on pooled overturned vs retained lengths): U=28916.0, p=0.0097, median overturned=98.5 (n=820), median retained=138.0 (n=85)

logistic_regression.direction: negative (longer predictions less likely to be rescued)

censoring.caveat: prediction length is right-censored by the logging pipeline; this biases the retained-group median down more than the overturned group's (higher censoring rate in retained), which if anything understates the true gap in this direction -- see Plan v3 F6/F2. A confirmatory analysis on untruncated Phase 2 re-run data is still required before this is reported as a final result.
